notes: Contact: Averi Jordan, ajorda22@gmu.edu. In 2026, 63 students went to the summit.
name: Conflict Resolution Youth Summit (CRYS)
org: George Mason University, Carter School for Peace and Conflict Resolution
what_you_do: A four-day overnight summit on campus. It has role plays, workshops and talks on world conflict, fairness and making peace. There is a trip to DC museums. You can add 1 college credit.
who_can_apply: Rising 10th, 11th and 12th graders who like leadership, making peace, community work or social sciences. Students come from all over the country.
pay_detail: $1,390 without college credit, or $1,500 with 1 college credit. Scholarship review is possible.
duration: Four days, overnight (page lists July 25 to 29 for Summer 2027)
deadline_text: Page says applications for 2027 open in January (2027) and the summit is in Summer 2027, July 25 to 29. Closing date not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application when it opens. If you are admitted, you get steps to sign up and pay a deposit. For a scholarship, check the box. Then send a personal statement and your parents' most recent 1040 tax form.
